pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-04.png with Read and looked at it directly. It read without problems. The page has 4 panels: a wide top panel, a middle row with left and right panels, and a wide bottom panel.
pages.observation: My reading order: (1) Top panel. 'Hello, Ravi. Tell me what brings you in.' The tail points to Ananya, who is on the left, with Ravi on the right. (2) Middle-left panel. 'I've been feeling tired lately.' The tail points to Ravi. Ananya appears only as a bare marker at the far left with no face box. (3) Middle-right panel. Narration caption 'Technology supports the workflow. The conversation stays human.' Ananya is in the centre and Ravi is only a bare marker at the far right edge. (4) Bottom panel. 'We'll go through your concerns and decide the right next steps together.' The tail points to Ananya, with Ravi on the right. Issues: (a) The move from reception to the consultation room is not signalled. Page 3 ends with 'have a seat' and page 4 opens with the doctor. (b) Ananya's direct reply to 'I've been feeling tired lately' is delayed by a promotional narration panel. Panel 3 reads as a listening beat only if Ananya's attentive reaction is clearly drawn. Otherwise the symptom gets no immediate response, and the narration interrupts a sensitive exchange. (c) 'Technology supports the workflow' refers to technology that is not shown anywhere in this consultation. Indicate a device or screen, or reconsider the caption. (d) In panels 1 and 4 the balloons and tails cover Ananya's placeholder label, and the tails are very short. (e) Left-right placement is consistent: Ananya left, Ravi right.
